title: External operation identity follows historical continuity, not table similarity
summary: SSC tracks SQL/CLI/external-operation identity across refactors. A moved operation can retain identity only with unambiguous historical continuity. Same SQL kind/table/source is compatibility evidence, never enough to consume an existing identity; one-to-many same-table additions remain new proposals.
invariants: Relocation is one-old to one-new after continuing locations are retained.
Ambiguous relocation remains a new/review proposal.
Method extraction does not erase the tracked external operation when continuity is unambiguous.
Gopher should render pending proposals and evidence but must not silently accept them.
